firm_data.firm_description: Bortstein Legal Group is a leader in the areas of technology, market data, digital content, privacy, cyber-security, outsourcing, vendor contracts and corporate real estate. Our global team negotiates thousands of customer-side IT, cloud, IP licensing, market data, digital content, artificial intelligence/machine learning and outsourcing transactions each year.
notable_facts: Offices in New York, London and Toronto
Extensive knowledge of global laws and regulations

email.subject: AI for Bortstein Legal Group, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Beth,

Bortstein's focus on technology transactions, market data, and AI/ML contracts puts you at the forefront of a practice area where precision and speed matter enormously. Your global team negotiates thousands of these deals annually, and I suspect AI-driven contract review could directly impact your margins.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Northeast to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
